source_title: Care of adults with neurofibromatosis type 1: a clinical practice resource of the American College of Medical Genetics and Genomics (ACMG)
claim_text: In a US health-insurance claims analysis of 8,579 NF1 patients and 85,790 matched non-NF1 individuals, NF1 adults had significantly higher odds of claims for headache, headache with migraine, epilepsy, and sleep disturbance/disorder, and the associations persisted after excluding brain-tumor-related claims.
notes: Full text from locally supplied PDF (Genet Med 2018;20:671-682; not in PMC). Statement made by the ACMG adult NF1 practice resource citing ref 106 Madubata 2015 PMID 24901347. Secondary citation: not independent of the cited primary work; primary paper should be read for strength grading.Administrative claims data; also reported higher odds of Parkinson's disease and multiple sclerosis in adults, but with few observations and a need for replication.
independence_flags: secondary citation via guideline PMID 30006586 of ref 106
